captions.detailed: A clip-on task lamp featuring a spring-loaded clamp base, an adjustable curved lower arm, a straight upper link, and a conical lamp shade. The assembly is constructed primarily from dark grey or black plastic/metal parts with light grey cylindrical pins serving as hinges. The lamp articulates via three revolute joints: one at the base of the lower arm, an elbow joint between the lower and upper arms, and a tilt joint connecting the shade to the upper arm.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated clip-on task lamp with a spring clamp base, a curved lower arm, a straight upper arm, and a conical shade. Ensure it includes revolute joints at the base, elbow, and shade attachment points, with realistic dark grey and light grey metallic materials.
captions.factory: Construct the lamp base using rectangular boxes for the clamp jaws and a cylinder for the central pivot pin. Form the lower arm from a swept profile or curved cylinder, capped with hinge blocks at both ends. Create the upper arm as a straight cylinder with matching end connectors. Model the conical shade using a hollowed-out cone primitive (or a lofted shell) and attach it to a final hinge bracket. Define three revolute joint connections linking the clamp, lower arm, upper arm, and shade sequentially.
